title: Program Fees, Setup Fee and Entry Requirements by Tier under the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs
content:
Before a tier of the Indoor Air Quality & Filtration Programs is written for a building, the quotation desk reads the tier's entry requirements and its fee basis from the schedule below.

## Fee basis and term

| Tier | Annual program fee before per-unit charges (USD per year) | Annual program charge per covered unit (USD per unit per year) | One-time setup fee to survey the filter schedule and set up the program (USD) | Length of one program term (calendar months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Filter Supply Program | 0 | 0 | 0 | 12 |
| Managed Filtration Program | 780 | 240 | 185 | 12 |
| Coil Hygiene Program | 1450 | 420 | 285 | 12 |
| Air Quality Monitoring Program | 3600 | 560 | 450 | 12 |
| UV & Purification Service Program | 5200 | 760 | 650 | 24 |
| Certified Indoor Air Quality Program | 12500 | 1180 | 1250 | 24 |

## Entry requirements

| Tier | Minimum covered units for the program to be written | Largest number of units one program may carry | Filter schedule survey required before the program is quoted | Active maintenance agreement at the site required |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Filter Supply Program | 2 | 60 | No | No |
| Managed Filtration Program | 2 | 40 | Yes | No |
| Coil Hygiene Program | 2 | 40 | Yes | Yes |
| Air Quality Monitoring Program | 4 | 30 | Yes | Yes |
| UV & Purification Service Program | 4 | 30 | Yes | Yes |
| Certified Indoor Air Quality Program | 6 | 60 | Yes | Yes |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The Filter Supply Program carries no annual program fee, no per-unit charge and no setup fee; it is the one tier written without a filter schedule survey and without a maintenance agreement at the site.
2. Two tiers run a 24-month term, the UV & Purification Service Program and the Certified Indoor Air Quality Program; the four tiers below them run a 12-month term.
3. The unit range is read at both ends. A tier is written for a building with a unit count from the minimum up to and including the maximum: a building with 3 covered units is inside the range of the Filter Supply Program, the Managed Filtration Program and the Coil Hygiene Program (minimum 2) and outside the range of the three tiers whose minimum is 4 or 6; a building with 45 covered units is outside the range of every tier whose maximum is 40 or 30 and inside the range of the two tiers whose maximum is 60.
